description: This file defines the AcknowledgementLabelInvalidException class, a specific type of runtime exception used in the Ditto framework to signal invalid acknowledgement labels. It includes multiple constructors for creating instances with different details, static methods for JSON deserialization, and is annotated for immutability and thread safety.
